references.text: Describes the freewill offering (terumah) collected from the people, a half shekel per person, as the basis for materials for the tabernacle
Mentions the freewill offering of bronze given as an offering for the Lord's work
Describes what the bronze from the freewill offering was used for: the sockets for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating, and all the utensils of the altar
Instructions for the bronze altar that the bronze from the freewill offering was used to make
Mentions bronze among the metals used in the service of the sanctuary
Thematic parallel: Both verses carefully document the counting of metal gifts given to the Lord by leaders/the people for holy use.
